Rail projects in Bihar

the Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased to

implemented by Government in Bihar;

complete the projects on time;

PANY: Will the Minister of CHEMICALS
AND FERTILIZERS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the fact that recently a massive fire incident
had occurred in the closed factory of the
Fertilizers Corporation of India situated at
Talcher under Angul district of Orissa;
(b) if so, the quantum of losses therein;
and
(c) whether it will have any bearing on
the announcement of Government to revive
this factory?
Diversion of PDS items
†*623. SHRI MAHENDRA SAHNI:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that 53.3 per cent
of wheat and 39 per cent of rice given in
ration under Accelerated PDS and
Antyodaya Yojana is sold in black-market
instead of being given to the needy people
in the country as per the study conducted
by ORG Centre for Social Research;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the steps being taken by
Government to check it strictly?
Interest Subvention Scheme
*624. SHRI KANJIBHAI PATEL: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
introduced an Interest Subvention Scheme

has pointed out certain difficulties to take
advantage of this scheme;

(e) the action taken by Government in
this regard?
Level of mercury in the air in
hospitals
*625. SHRI N.R. GOVINDARAJAR:
Will the Minister of ENVIRONMENT
AND FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there are
high levels of mercury in our country found
in the air in hospitals which threaten the
health of patients and medical staff;
(b) whether it is also a fact that US has
come forward to help our country to reduce
such high levels of mercury containment;
and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Problems of Agri-extension Services
*626. SHRI C. RAMACHANDRAIAH:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
tackle the problems of Agri-extension
Services such as poor reach to fields, lack
of specialization, knowledge/skills on
markets and their operations, etc.;

private extension research and farmer's
training is contemplated;

companies which would be roped in; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?

Will the Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased
to state:
(a) the average annual requirement of
electricity of the Railways;
(b) the charges of electricity for
operation of trains per unit;
(c) whether the Railways have decided
to set up a captive power plant in
collaboration with NTPC with a view to
get power at cheaper rates; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Making barren land cultivable
†*628. SHRI SHAHID SIDDIQUI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) the cultivable land in hectares at
present in the country;
(b) the barren land in hectares and the
steps taken by Government during the last
five years to make it cultivables, State-wise;
and
(c) the total amount spent during the
last five years for converting the barren
land cultivable, State-wise?
Persons employed in khadi textile
industry
†*629.SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
SHRI RAJ MOHINDER SINGH
MAJITHA:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND
RURAL INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that 13.16 lakh
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

198
persons were employed in khadi textile
industry in the country during 1994-95
whereas this number has declined to 8.70
lakhs only during 2005-06;
(b) if not, the facts in this regard; and
(c) the reasons for less production in
the industry during the said period in spite
of the efforts made by Government for its
expansion and development?

Himachal Pradesh
*630. SHRIMATI VIPLOVE
THAKUR: Will the Minister of
RAILWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
introduce new trains for various States of
the country during the year 2007-08;
(b) if so, the number of new trains
proposed to be introduced for Himachal
Pradesh; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Production by RINL
*631. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of STEEL be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the RINL (Vizag Steel Plant)
has celebrated its 25 years of operation;
(b) what is the total production of steel
of RINL since its inception, year-wise;
(c) to what extent the viability and
economic stability of the RINL plant at
Visakhapatnam is linked to the Chinese
demand for steel;
(d) the steps proposed to plan
expansions and investments without totally
becoming China Centric; and
(e) the details of studies which would
be commissioned to assess future
projections without depending on China?
Schemes for cleaning the rivers
†*632. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the Minister of ENVIRONMENT
AND FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
had implemented schemes for cleaning of
water of various rivers in the country during
the last two decades;
(b) if so, the names of such rivers and
the amount spent on scheme formulated
for cleaning of water of each river;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the water
of above said rivers has become even more
polluted after introduction and completion
of the said schemes; and
(d) if so, Government's reaction thereto?
Revival of Durgapur Plant
*633. SHRI TAPAN KUMAR SEN:
  SHRI PRASANTA
CHATTERJEE:
Will the Minister of CHEMICALS
AND FERTILIZERS be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Rashtriya Chemicals
and Fertilizers (RCF) has shown interest
in reviving Durgapur unit of HFC;
(b) whether KRIBHCO had shown
similar interest in reviving Durgapur unit;
(c) if so, the action taken by Government
on the same, so far;
(d) whether RCF or KRIBHCO has
been asked to submit any revival plan;
(e) if so, the tentative revival cost
vis-à-vis techno-economic viability;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

199
(f) if not, the reasons therefor; and
(g) the specific steps taken by
Government to preserve plant and
equipments of the unit likely to be utilized
for revival?
Share of public spending on
health
*634. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that as per a
study, India lags behind in public spending
on health against the total health spending
of 20.7 per cent as compared to Pakistan
34.9 per cent, China 33.7 per cent,
Germany 78.5 per cent and UK 83.4 per
cent;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor; and
(c) the steps proposed to be taken to
increase the share of public spending on
health?
Irrigation facilities
†*635. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA:
SHRI KRISHAN LAL
BALMIKI:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there are no
irrigation facilities in the 60 per cent of
agricultural land of the country;
(b) if so, the steps being taken by
Government in this regard; and
(c) whether Government are
implementing dry land farming and micro-
irrigation schemes?
REGP through Khadi and Village
Industries Commission
*636. SHRIMATI HEMA MALINI:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have launched the Rural Employment
Generation Programme (REGP) from 1st
April, 1995 through the Khadi and Village
Industries Commission in order to generate
more employment opportunities; and
(b) if so, what is the response thereof in
rural areas?
Incentives to women entrepreneurs of
Goa
*637. SHRI SHANT ARAM
LAXMAN NAIK: Will the Minister of
SMALL SCALE INDUSTRIES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether schemes for incentives to
women entrepreneurs are in force in Goa;
(b) if so, the essential features of the
schemes;
(c) the projects undertaken/
implemented under the schemes during the
last five years in the State; and
(d) the details of financial assistance
granted to the State during that period, year-
wise?
Revival of khadi industry
*638. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND
RURAL INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
revive khadi industry for employment
generation;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the action plan to revive this sector
in Orissa especially in the tribal-segments,
to improve economy of the backward
region?
Human labour based techniques
†*639. SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
Will the Minister of AGRICUL TURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that human labour
based techniques are more beneficial in
agriculture sector of the country in
comparison to machine-based techniques;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reaction of Government in this regard;
(c) whether the farmers of some major
wheat producing States have accepted the
fact that the use of human labour based
technique is beneficial from economic point
of view; and
(d) if so, the names of those States?
RCH Programme
*640. SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
SHRIMATI SUPRIYA SULE:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:

loan agreements worth $792 million (about
Rs. 3564 crores) with the World Bank for
three health sector projects;
(b) if so, whether the World Bank would
extend $360 million to the Reproductive
and Child Health Project and 170 million
to the second National Tuberculosis
Control Programme;
(c) if so, what are the other main details
of the project that would be undertaken by
the World Bank loan; and

be implemented?

Hiring of tuna training boats by
CIFNET
4742. DR. M.A.M. RAMASWAMY:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have given
permission to the Central Institute of
Fisheries Nautical and Engineering Training
(CIFNET) to hire tuna training boats from
Norway and other countries;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) how many people would be trained
on one such hired tuna boat in a year;
(d) whether it would be cheaper to send
Indian youths for training abroad at much
lower costs; and
(e) the steps proposed to study the
costs of training with hired boats, etc. by
CIFNET?
Food security
4743. SHRI AMAR SINGH:
SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that food security
is coming under renewed strain with
growing shortfalls in foodgrains and
vegetables;
(b) if so, the details of production and
requirement of foodgrains during the last
two years; and
(c) whether it is a fact that private
companies have started to purchase
foodgrains directly from the farmers at a
much higher rate than the rate fixed by
Government and if so, how much purchase
these companies have made, so far, and at
what rate?

4744. SHRI MOTIUR RAHMAN: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be

body/delegates of Kendriya Bhandar was
held in 1999 for three years and if so, the
reasons for not holding the elections in
2002; and
(b) what action is proposed to be taken
against the central registrar of MSCS and
Kendriya Bhandar for failing to perform
their duties in the matter of holding the
election to the general body in time?

sub section (5) of section 45 of MSCS Act,
2002, the term of office of elected directors
shall be five years from the date of the
election;

directors of Kendriya Bhandar was held in
2003 by the expired general body; and

†4746. SHRI SHREEGOPAL VYAS:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether role of fertilizers has been
contemplated in view of declining
production capacity of land;

effects of dung and other bio-fertilizers
compared to chemical fertilizers has also
been contemplated; and

a system of large scale distribution of
domestic fertilizers after their collection in
small packets is under consideration?
2007 as the year of farmers

problems being faced by farmers in the

SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:

Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that global

substantially the cereal production potential
